event_records.description: Priya intends to contact Maple Row Dental front desk to reschedule her Thursday cleaning.

priya.name: Priya
priya.persona_brief:
You are Priya.
Priya has a dental cleaning scheduled for Thursday, but needs to reschedule due to a work trip. She wants to find a new slot by Wednesday noon.

maple_row_dental_front_desk.name: Maple Row Dental front desk
maple_row_dental_front_desk.persona_brief:
You are Maple Row Dental front desk.
The front desk handles appointment scheduling and can offer available slots. They are aware of Priya's existing Thursday appointment.

resolution.question: Priya needs to move her Thursday dental cleaning because of a work trip. Will she and the Maple Row Dental front desk agree on a new slot by Wednesday noon?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Priya and the Maple Row Dental front desk have agreed on a new appointment slot before 2026-08-12T12:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
